rules: A claim may not state a rung its evidence does not reach.
A claim and its evidence land in the same commit or neither lands.
When execution contradicts a claim, narrow the claim in the same change and record it in DECISIONS.md.
Forbidden vocabulary: guaranteed, safe, liquid, always, protected, insured, risk-free.

claims.claim: A breach is recorded only from a stored, block-pinned sample.
A third party with no access to our systems can re-derive a recorded verdict from chain alone.
Samples were delivered by the Somnia reactivity path on a live market.
A real quoting breach was recorded against a live DreamDEX event contract market.
A forfeited bond was paid to witnessed traders, pro rata, on chain.
Sampling gaps are recorded as NOT_SAMPLED and are never counted as coverage.
A first-time user published a commitment unaided from the live app.
